title: Typo in a word? Delete the whole word in 1 press ⚡ #Shorts
description:
Hitting Backspace again and again to remove one wrong word? One shortcut deletes the whole word at once.

⌨️ Windows: Ctrl + Backspace
🍎 Mac: Option + Delete

Works in most text boxes, browsers and editors. Add Shift on Mac (Cmd + Delete) to delete the whole line.

A new life-saving tip every day, in 15 seconds. Save this for later and subscribe 🔔
